items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Freddie Coleman, Jack Willis, Sam Dutra, we've been working together off and on for about the last 23, 24 years.

ctx.x: Nothing else? I was thinking you were-
I made a lot of recording but not this type of music. Outside of Paul and Freddie, just quickly with MGM.
